about: The /features/ page (#2101). `today`: what the game does on main, each with the repo path that shows it. `later`: what is planned, each with the number of the issue that tracks it (the reviewer checks it is still open). `node scripts/site-features.mjs` renders website/features/index.html; tests/unit/site-features.test.ts holds the rules.

today.title: Missions
today.blurb: Every topic is a mission of five waves that get harder as they go, with lives to keep and up to three stars to win.

today.title: Sky Storm
today.blurb: An endless storm of mixed questions that speeds up the longer a child keeps going, with Hammer Man's TNT bubbles to avoid.

today.title: Ninja Sprint
today.blurb: Sixty seconds to slice as many right answers as possible, with no lives to lose.

today.title: Boss Battle
today.blurb: Right answers knock down Hammer Man's health bar until he is out.

today.title: Ninja Duel
today.blurb: Two players share one device and one question, and the first right slice wins the round.

today.title: Memory Match
today.blurb: A calm card game of finding matching pairs, with no slicing.

today.title: Train with Sensei
today.blurb: Sensei picks the topics a child finds hardest and puts them into one practice session.

today.title: Letter tracing
today.blurb: Reception children trace letters with a finger, starting with the ones they learn to read first.

today.title: Daily Dojo
today.blurb: Three new challenges every day, with bonus coins and a streak for coming back.

today.title: Tables Check practice
today.blurb: Year 4 practice with the same timing as the multiplication tables check: 25 questions, 6 seconds each.

today.title: Arithmetic practice
today.blurb: Year 6 practice in the style of the arithmetic paper: ten questions, at the paper's own pace.

today.title: Statutory spelling lists
today.blurb: Every word on the statutory Year 3–4 and Year 5–6 spelling lists.

today.title: Coins and the Ninja Shop
today.blurb: Right answers earn coins, which buy new slice trails in the Ninja Shop.

today.title: Sticker album
today.blurb: Stickers of the ninjas and Hammer Man fill an album as coins add up and a child tries new topics, bosses and years.

today.title: Certificates
today.blurb: Winning a mission makes a certificate to print or share, and every certificate is kept in an album.

today.title: Belts and trophies
today.blurb: Ninja belts grow with the stars earned across every topic, and each topic has a bronze, silver or gold trophy to win in Ninja Sprint.

today.title: Four children, one device
today.blurb: Up to four children can each have their own ninja and their own progress on one phone, tablet or computer.

today.title: The grown-ups' area
today.blurb: Behind a quick sum, grown-ups see questions answered, accuracy, stars and the topics a child finds hardest.

today.title: Progress report
today.blurb: Grown-ups can share a short progress summary as text or as a one-page picture.

today.title: Read aloud
today.blurb: Questions can be read aloud, so children who cannot read yet can still play.

today.title: Slower bubbles and extra time
today.blurb: Grown-ups can slow the bubbles down, and give extra time or no time limit on timed questions.

today.title: Whiteboard mode
today.blurb: For a class at the front of the room: slower bubbles, questions read aloud, practice with no lives, and nothing saved.

today.title: Reception to Year 6
today.blurb: Seven islands, one for each school year from Reception to Year 6, each with maths and English topics.

today.title: Plays offline and installs
today.blurb: After the first visit it plays without a connection, and it can be added to the home screen like an app.

today.title: Move to another device
today.blurb: A save code carries a child's progress to another phone, tablet or computer.

today.title: No adverts, no tracking
today.blurb: No adverts, no analytics and no account: progress is kept on the device.

later.title: Sharpwise on Google Play
later.blurb: An Android app in the Google Play store, made for families.

later.title: Sharpwise on the App Store
later.blurb: An app for iPhone and iPad.

later.title: A recorded voice
later.blurb: A real recorded voice for the game's everyday phrases, in place of the device's computer voice.

later.title: Celebration poses
later.blurb: Each ninja celebrating a win in a pose of its own.

later.title: A 3-D Sky Map
later.blurb: The Sky Map as floating 3-D islands.

later.title: Schools and classes
later.blurb: A way for a teacher to set up a class for the children to join.
